contentAfterToc.text: Common Mistakes to Avoid in Responsive Design

contentAfterToc.alt: Common Mistakes to Avoid in Responsive Design

content: : If your website is slow on mobile, visitors will leave without exploring your website. Avoid using heavy images, large videos, or too many popups. The simpler your website design, the faster it works on mobile.

: Don’t create buttons too small. It can create issues with the mobile screen, and the user gets frustrated. Keep text readable without zooming, so the readers can easily read the content and won’t leave your website. Your website should be easy to use with just one hand on a mobile.
: Always test your website on phones, tablets, and desktops. What looks good on one screen may not work on another because every device has a different screen size and specifications.
